newsitem.title: JAPAN: N.Korea says South, US taking advantage of famine.
newsitem.headline: N.Korea says South, US taking advantage of famine.

text.p: North Korea on Friday again accused the United States and South Korea of preparing to stage a war, this time saying they should not take advantage of the fact that North Korean soldiers are now farming to stave off famine.
Pyongyang's official newspaper Rodong Sinmun said Washington and Seoul were cashing in on the food situation in North Korea which forced its soldiers to take part in farming.

"Taking advantage of the participation of a large number of units of the Korean People's Army in farming, the U.S. and the South Korean puppets are going to unleash a war against the DPRK (North Korea)," the newspaper said.
The report was carried by the Korean Central News Agency, monitored in Tokyo.
Severe floods destroyed food stocks and grain harvests in North Korea in 1995 and 1996, pushing the Stalinist state to the brink of famine.
Friday's statement followed stern warnings issued by Pyongyang for two days in a row that North Korea was ready for a "final battle" with the United States and South Korea.
"The obtaining situation makes it incumbent upon us to be fully ready for any challenge," the North Korean daily said.
"We are prepared to defend the sovereignty and dignity of the country at the risk of our lives and have made full preparations for annihilating the aggressors," it said.
"The provokers will get nothing but a shameful defeat and death," it added.
